subject: Platform transition playbook: consolidating compliance vendors
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Platform transition playbook — initial ask

Team,

Quick context: with Dedicated growth and more enterprise deals asking for consolidated evidence, I want to evaluate moving us from a two-tool approach (TrustCenter + boutique consultants) to a single primary compliance partner. Goal: reduce evidence duplication, shorten audit prep, and capture a small run-rate discount. Attached is a first-pass scorecard.

Asks:
- Monica: can you populate cost/effort columns and ETA to migrate existing evidence?
- Priyom: reach out to Drata + TrustCenter for updated SOWs and a 30/60/90 onboarding plan.
- Laura: we’ll likely need a small procurement approval if discounts are below our threshold — can you flag the routing?

I’d like a consolidated recommendation by EOD Feb 17.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

--- Attachment: platform_consolidation_scorecard.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

-----Original Message-----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Platform transition playbook — initial ask

Marissa —

I reviewed the scorecard and added estimated 12-mo TCO for both setups (sheet tab: cost_breakdown). Highlights:
- Drata: higher upfront onboarding (~$35k) but lower recurring ($8k/mo).
- TrustCenter: lower onboarding (~$20k) but add-on marketplace fees and per-audit hours push to ~$11k/mo.
- Consultants (Chronicle): flexible but variable; expect ~4 weeks of heavy lift per audit cycle.

I flagged migration risk items (evidence formats, SSO mappings). See comments in sheet. I can do a technical deep-dive with Priyom next week.

-Monica
Monica Patel
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference

-----Forwarded message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@drata.com>, TrustCenter Sales <sales@trustcenter.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: RFP follow-up — onboarding SOW and timeline request

Emily / TrustCenter team —

Thanks for the initial calls last week. We’re completing an internal scorecard and would like:
1) A 30/60/90 day onboarding SOW with key milestones and estimated Redwood team hours.
2) A one-page pricing summary for a consolidated deployment (all evidence ingestion, SOC2 continuous monitoring, and two annual readiness reviews).
3) Any migration tools or scripts you provide for evidence export/import.

Please attach proposals to your reply. We’ll share a consolidated recommendation with Procurement on Feb 18.

Best,
Marissa

---

-----Reply from Emily Park (Drata)-----
From: Emily Park <emily.park@drata.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 11:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — onboarding SOW and timeline request

Marissa / Priyom —

Great to connect. Attaching our standard proposal tailored to Redwood (high level). Key notes:
- 30/60/90: we can hit SOC2 readiness in ~10 weeks assuming SSO + SCIM ready; weekly syncs with your security team.
- Migration: we provide an evidence import utility (CSV + API) and offer one day of migration work per major evidence group.
- Pricing: $32,500 onboarding (one-time) + $7,500/mo. We can extend a 10% discount for a 12-month committed contract.

Attachment: drata-proposal-Feb2027.pdf

Happy to do a pricing walk-through Thursday.

Best,
Emily Park
Enterprise Solutions, Drata
emily.park@drata.com

-----Reply from TrustCenter Sales-----
From: sales@trustcenter.io <sales@trustcenter.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — onboarding SOW and timeline request

Marissa / team —

Appreciate the opportunity. Quick summary:
- Onboarding: ~8 weeks for core controls. We include marketplace connectors for Jira/Okta at no extra charge.
- Migration tooling: export helpers available; professional services estimate ~$18k for full migration support.
- Pricing: $20k onboarding + $10k/mo (includes premium connectors).

We can commit to a 6% uplift-free integration with Redwood Console for telemetry ingestion.

Attachment: trustcenter-sow-draft.pdf

Regards,
TrustCenter Sales

-----Final internal note-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 16:35:00 -0800
Subject: Recommendation & next steps: pilot with Drata + procurement routing

Team —

Recommendation: run a 90-day pilot with Drata (reduced onboarding milestone, include proof-of-concept for evidence import), while keeping TrustCenter as fallback for two high-sensitivity customers who require their connectors. Reasoning: lower run-rate after onboarding plus migration tooling speeds the switch.

Next steps:
- Laura: please start procurement routing for a $32.5k onboarding + 12 months at $7.5k/mo with 10% discount applied (details in drive link).
- Monica: schedule technical kickoff with Drata and allocate two engineers for the first 4 weeks.
- Priyom: confirm export paths for evidence and SSO readiness checklist.

I’ll book a 30m sync Friday to finalize procurement packet.

Marissa
---
Attachments referenced: platform_consolidation_scorecard.xlsx; drata-proposal-Feb2027.pdf; trustcenter-sow-draft.pdf
